fusions.name: Wide Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted mesh 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 10 damage to everything under it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Tight
fusions.desc: Casts a drawstring loop that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Haul the Catch
fusions.desc: A practised heave that drags up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Flat
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
